title: A simple 3D cellular chemotaxis assay and analysis workflow suitable for a wide range of migrating cells
author: Visweshwaran, Maritzen

steps.title: Assemble migration chamber
steps.instruction: Inside a laminar‑flow hood, pipette 10 μl mounting medium onto one half of the plastic rim of a 35 mm dish (21 mm wide, ~1 mm deep glass‑bottom indentation). Using sterile forceps, place a 22 mm circular glass coverslip so it contacts the chamber wall, leaving part of the indentation uncovered and creating a pocket‑like cavity.

steps.title: Dry mounting medium
steps.instruction: Incubate the dish for 30–60 min at room temperature inside the laminar‑flow hood to allow the mounting medium to dry.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells of interest, count them and resuspend in complete medium (containing FBS, antibiotics and required supplements) to a final concentration of 0.5 × 10⁶ cells · ml⁻¹. Keep the suspension at room temperature and proceed quickly to the next step.

steps.title: Prepare collagen‑cell mixture
steps.instruction: Keep ingredients #1‑4 on ice. In a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube, pipette 15 μl 1× MEM, 5 μl 2 NaHCO₃ and 35 μl 1× MEM; mix gently on ice. Add the appropriate volume of Collagen I (3 mg ml⁻¹) – 70 μl for DCs (final 1.4 mg ml⁻¹) or 80 μl for MDA‑MB‑231 (final 1.6 mg ml⁻¹) – and mix very gently without bubbles. Finally add 25 μl cell suspension (0.5 × 10⁶ cells · ml⁻¹) and mix gently. Total volume = 150 μl.

steps.title: Load collagen gel into chamber
steps.instruction: Hold the prepared migration chamber vertically and pipette 130 μl of the collagen‑cell mixture gently into the pocket‑like cavity.

steps.title: Settle the gel
steps.instruction: While still holding the dish vertically, gently tap it a couple of times against the bench surface so the gel settles to the bottom of the cavity and forms a straight, even meniscus.

steps.title: Allow cells to settle
steps.instruction: Place the dish horizontally and let the suspended cells settle evenly within the gel.

steps.title: Incubate for gelation
steps.instruction: Close the dish with its locking lid to prevent drying. Incubate in a cell‑culture incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 30–60 min until the collagen gel becomes slightly milky white and collagen fibers are uniformly visible.

steps.title: Open migration video in Fiji
steps.instruction: Open the background‑subtracted 3D migration video in Fiji.

steps.title: Start TrackMate
steps.instruction: In Fiji, choose Plugins → Tracking → TrackMate, verify the image properties, then click Next.

steps.title: Configure LoG detector
steps.instruction: Select LoG Detector. For DCs set Estimated blob diameter = 30 μm, Threshold = 25, Use median filter = No, Do sub‑pixel localization = Yes. For MDA‑MB‑231 set Estimated blob diameter = 40 μm, Threshold = 25, Use median filter = No, Do sub‑pixel localization = Yes. Click Next.

steps.title: Run cell detection
steps.instruction: Allow the software to recognize the cells, then click Next.

steps.title: Set initial thresholding
steps.instruction: Choose ‘Initial thresholding: Quality – Auto’ and click Next.

steps.title: Set view options
steps.instruction: Select ‘Hyperstack Display’ and click Next.

steps.title: Set spot display options
steps.instruction: Set ‘Filters on spots’ to No selection and ‘Set color by’ to Uniform color, then click Next.

steps.title: Select Simple LAP tracker
steps.instruction: Choose ‘Simple LAP tracker’ and click Next.

steps.title: Configure Simple LAP tracker
steps.instruction: Set Linking max distance = 50 μm, Gap‑closing max distance = 50 μm, Gap‑closing max frame gap = 8, then click Next.

steps.title: Run tracking
steps.instruction: Let the software process the cell tracking, then click Next.

steps.title: Filter tracks
steps.instruction: Click the (+) button and select ‘Maximal quality: Auto’; click (+) again and select ‘Duration of tracks: Auto’. Set ‘Set color by’ to Track index, then click Next.

steps.title: Export spot‑track data
steps.instruction: Keep ‘Display spot’, ‘Display tracks’ and ‘Limit frame depth’ enabled; leave other options unchecked. Click Analysis, copy the data from the ‘Spots in tracks statistics’ window into the supplemental Excel file TrackMate_data.xlsm (sheet1), save the file, then click Next.

steps.title: Skip spots/links/tracks sections
steps.instruction: In the subsequent windows, skip the ‘Spots’, ‘Links’ and ‘Tracks’ sections by clicking Next.

steps.title: Create overlay video
steps.instruction: Select ‘Capture overlay’, execute to generate a video with tracks overlaid, and save the file.

steps.title: Process TrackMate data in Excel
steps.instruction: Open the TrackMate_data Excel file, enable the Developer tab (Excel Options → Customize Ribbon → check Developer). In Developer → Macros, run ‘Processing_TrackMate_data’; this creates ‘Temp’ and ‘For_Analysis’ sheets. The final migration trajectory data are in columns D, E, F of ‘For_Analysis’; the total number of tracks appears in column A, row 2.

steps.title: Extract subset of tracks (optional)
steps.instruction: If a specific number of tracks is desired, run the macro ‘Cell_tracks_by_cell_number_input’; the selected tracks will be placed in columns J, K, L.
